taste:
This basket offers gently savoury chicken with a clear contrast between its crunchy coating and soft, juicy centre. The batter is described as light and golden, so the appeal is as much about texture as flavour. Bite-sized pieces make it a straightforward choice if you prefer smaller bites of chicken to a half-chicken dish.

Served hot in a basket, it comes with a hearty helping of chips and a dipping sauce of your choice. The dip adds tang to the otherwise gently savoury combination. For someone after familiar pub food, the chicken, batter, chips and sauce give it a simple, comforting character without a complicated set of components.
